summary: Frontend-only re-test of the new portfolio.tsx additions on https://trade-agent-app.preview.emergentagent.com/portfolio (viewport 390x844). Backend intentionally NOT tested per agent-to-agent context (portfolio.tsx is the only changed file; prior iteration 6 = 51/51 backend + 6/6 API integration PASS). All 6 requested flows PASS: (1) SEARCH DROPDOWN — typing 'APP' produced 6 results (APP, AAPL, APLD, AMAT, AAOI, SAAPL=F) in <1.6s; tapping AAPL filled the symbol field with 'AAPL'. (2) SINGLE-HOLDING HINT — with exactly 1 holding (AAPL 10@150) the hint 'Add at least one more holding to run the optimizer.' rendered and the OPTIMIZE card was hidden. (3) ANALYZE-MISSING BUTTON APPEARS — with holdings PLBY 10@5 + BBAI 20@3 and 'Use agent views' ON, RUN OPTIMIZER surfaced the note 'No cached analysis for PLBY, BBAI — their weight is based on price history only.' and the 'ANALYZE MISSING (2) & RE-RUN' button. (4) ANALYZE-MISSING RUNS & RE-OPTIMIZES — tapping the button switched label to 'ANALYZING PLBY…' at t=5s, then 'ANALYZING BBAI…' at t=30s, then at t=60s the button and the missing-note both disappeared and the optimizer auto re-ran (final result: TRIM BBAI 83.4%→46.5%, ADD PLBY 16.6%→53.5%, EXP.RETURN -12.7%, VOLATILITY 64.1%, SHARPE -0.20, 'Not financial advice' note present). Total analyze pipeline finished in ~60s across both symbols on this run — faster than the 40–60s per-symbol worst case called out in the spec. (5) WATCHLIST QUICK-ADD — with the watchlist_v1 store seeded (TSLA, NVDA) the 'FROM WATCHLIST:' row rendered both chips; tapping TSLA populated the SEARCH SYMBOL field with 'TSLA' (confirming pre-existing addFromWatchlist behavior is intact). (6) NON-REGRESSION — SUGGESTED ACTIONS card renders per-symbol ADD/TRIM badges with current%→suggested% pill, EXP.RETURN/VOLATILITY/SHARPE row, and the 'Not financial advice' footnote; no red screen, no PAGEERROR captured across all four Playwright runs. One minor UX note (below) and the pre-existing 390px-width layout regression from iteration_6 are still present and are the only observations for the main agent.

ui_bugs.issue: After tapping a search result, pickSearchResult() clears searchResults but the useEffect on form.symbol fires 300ms later with the newly-set ticker (e.g. 'AAPL') and re-populates the dropdown with a single row for that same ticker. Net effect: the dropdown briefly closes then re-opens showing e.g. 'AAPL — Apple Inc.' until the user taps ADD or types something else. Spec asked for 'tapping a result fills the field and closes the dropdown' — the field is filled, but the dropdown does not stay closed. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx:48-78. Suggested fix: track a 'justPicked' ref or compare q against searchResults[0]?.symbol and skip the fetch when they match.

issues: Pre-existing 390px overflow in the ADD HOLDING row is still present (unchanged in this diff). On a 390px viewport the SEARCH SYMBOL TextInput is not visible at all in the initial paint — only QTY and AVG PRICE fit inside the card, and the ADD button is off-screen right. The elements exist in the DOM (Playwright fills succeed via placeholder) but a real user cannot see or tap the primary symbol field on a 375–390px phone without horizontal scrolling. File: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx:201-247 (formRow + input flex ratios 1.4/1/1.2 + fixed-width addBtn all on one flex-row). Already reported in iteration_6.json (design_issues); not blocking the six functional flows tested here because the dropdown-tap flow works from the DOM.

action_items: LOW: guard the search useEffect from re-firing immediately after pickSearchResult so the dropdown stays closed after selection (spec expectation).
MEDIUM (pre-existing): wrap the ADD HOLDING form onto two rows below ~400px, or shrink AVG PRICE flex, or move the ADD button to its own line — see iteration_6 design_issues; still unresolved.
critical_code_review_comments: portfolio.tsx analyzeMissing() has no timeout / max-iterations on the setInterval polling of /api/analysis/{id}. If the backend leaves an analysis stuck in status='running' forever, the button stays in 'ANALYZING {symbol}…' with no user recourse (would need a page reload). Consider a cap (e.g. abort after N minutes) and re-enable the button.

portfolio.tsx analyzeMissing() ignores the completed analysis result — it never checks whether the just-run analysis actually landed a verdict with a target. That is intentional per the agent-to-agent note (HOLD verdicts legitimately still lack an agent 'view'), but the UI has no messaging when a symbol stays in missing_agent_view_for after analyze, which can look like a bug to users. Consider a subtle note like 'analyzed but no directional view — kept as HOLD' next to still-missing symbols after re-run.

portfolio.tsx line 44 stores analyzingMissing as a single string, so the disable+label logic is single-flight — correct for the sequential loop, but if the user leaves the page mid-run, the loop keeps executing against a stale symbol list and then calls setResult on an unmounted component (React logs a warning). Not observed in this run because tests stayed on the tab.
portfolio.tsx useEffect at line 184 (`storage.setItem(KEY_CASH, cash)`) writes on every keystroke of the UNINVESTED CASH input — cheap in practice but noisy. Debounce would be nicer.

success_rate.backend: N/A (skipped per review scope — unchanged since iteration_6 100%)

seed_data_creation: Playwright pre-seeded per-test client state via localStorage: (a) portfolio:holdings = [{PLBY,10,5},{BBAI,20,3}] for the analyze-missing flow; (b) watchlist_v1 = double-JSON-encoded [{TSLA},{NVDA}] for the quick-add chip test (AsyncStorage web wrapper JSON.stringifies the value that watchlist.tsx has already JSON.stringified, so a raw seed requires double-encode). Real DB writes: the analyze-missing tap invoked POST /api/analyze for PLBY and BBAI (each ran to completion, ~30s each) — those two Analysis documents now exist in Mongo with status='completed'. No other backend state was mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: portfolio.tsx is now the only file changed vs. iteration_6. All six flows in the review request are working end-to-end. For future retesters: (a) AAPL and MSFT already have cached completed analyses from iteration_6 — use PLBY, BBAI, or other small-cap tickers to force missing_agent_view_for population. (b) AsyncStorage on web uses localStorage keys; portfolio:holdings expects the value single-JSON-stringified while watchlist_v1 expects double-JSON-stringified (watchlist.tsx wraps its own JSON.stringify inside storage.setItem). (c) The Expo web layout of the ADD HOLDING row overflows on 390px — pass form values via placeholder-based Playwright fills (they succeed via DOM) instead of visual clicks. (d) The Analyze-missing flow ran in ~60s total for 2 symbols on this pod; the spec's 40–60s per symbol is a worst case, not a floor, so a 30s-per-symbol observation is normal. (e) After running the analyze-missing flow both symbols dropped out of missing_agent_view_for on this run (both got a directional verdict); on runs where they get HOLD they will legitimately still appear in the note even after analyze — that is per-design per the agent-to-agent note.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug. One low-priority UX polish item (search dropdown re-opens after selection) and a pre-existing (iteration_6) responsive-layout regression on ≤390px are the only findings.
